description: This file defines a MediaAttachmentCache class for managing media attachments, including fetching, caching, and file path resolution, with support for local and remote media sources.

classes.name: MediaAttachmentCache
classes.description: A class for caching and managing media attachments, supporting local and remote fetching, path resolution, and cleanup.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the media buffer for a specific attachment, fetching from cache, local file, or remote source as needed.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Provides the file path for a media attachment, creating a temporary file if necessary.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up temporary files created during processing.

methods.name: ensureEntry
methods.description: Ensures an attachment cache entry exists for a given index, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves the local file system path for an attachment.

methods.name: ensureLocalStat
methods.description: Checks and caches the file size of a local attachment, verifying path validity.

methods.name: getCanonicalLocalPathRoots
methods.description: Computes and caches the canonical roots for local media paths.

methods.name: readLocalBuffer
methods.description: Reads a local file into a buffer, respecting path restrictions and size limits.
